# miniz, pinned for LM's heapless resident-slot compression

Upstream: https://github.com/richgel999/miniz

Release: 3.1.0, commit `174573d60290f447c13a2b1b3405de2b96e27d6c`.
The upstream MIT notice is in `LICENSE` and must accompany distributed binaries.

Only the low-level `tdefl`/`tinfl` APIs are called. Allocation, ZIP archive,
stdio, time and zlib compatibility APIs are disabled. All state is caller-owned
MEM2 workspace; no game heap or giant MEM1/stack object is used.

Local portability additions:

- `lm_miniz_config.h` selects these options and supplies freestanding PPC types
  and memory-function declarations.
- `miniz_common.h` and `miniz.h` omit hosted standard headers only under
  `LM_MINIZ_FREESTANDING`.
- `miniz_export.h` is the static-library export header normally generated by
  upstream CMake.

The algorithm source files are unchanged. The native tests compile the same
`lm_state_deflate.cpp` bridge and check cross-compatibility with host zlib.
